title: Alternative Firing Workshop
source_quote: Alternative Firing Workshop $ 375 usd Register Fri, Oct 23, 2026, 12:00 PM EDT – Sun, Oct 25, 2026, 5:00 PM EDT
evidence_sentence: The workshop page describes exploring Raku & Naked Raku, Saggar firing, Horse Hair firing, Obvara method, terra sigillata, and burnishing.
evidence_quote: Explore a variety of dynamic techniques, including Raku & Naked Raku, Saggar firing, and Horse Hair firing.
summary: A three-day hands-on pottery workshop (Oct 23–25, 2026) exploring raku, saggar, horse hair, and Obvara (Baltic Raku) firing, plus terra sigillata and burnishing. Intermediate/Advanced level. Students bring their own bisque-ware (fired to cone 06 for raku). Cost is $375; one spot remains.
commitment: Fri 12–5 PM, Sat 9 AM–5 PM, Sun 9 AM–3 PM
bring: Greenware (3–4 bone dry pieces for burnishing), bisque-ware (4–5 pieces fired to cone 06 for raku), soft natural bristle brush, 2 disposable sponge brushes, 2 yogurt-sized containers
how_to_join: Register online at the event page
